description: Every weekend of the next 12 months for one origin-destination pair, with the cheapest round-trip price per weekend and the time the price was observed ("as_of"). Cached prices answer at once; weekends not priced yet are searched live during the call, the way a page visit searches them (usually 10-40 s, at most ~55 s). If the search does not finish, the answer says which weekends are still open and to call again. Takes every filter the route page has: trip shape (combo), cabin, stops, passengers, departure and return time windows, currency. Free: fri-sun, economy, any stops, any passenger mix, no time window. Pro session cookie: other combos, other cabins, time windows.

adults.description: Default 1. Free. At most 9 travellers in total.

cabin.description: Default "economy" (free). Other cabins need a Pro session cookie.

combo.description: Trip shape: out day and back day as "{out}-{back}" with 3-letter days ("tue-thu"); the same day twice is a day trip. Default "fri-sun" (free). Other shapes need a Pro session cookie.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Default: the native currency of the origin (ZRH → CHF, BCN → EUR).

out_from.description: Earliest outbound departure, "HH:MM" local. Pro. Cached only for weekends whose flight detail is stored.

name: weekend_prices
title: Weekend round-trip prices for one route
